An '''Imperial Base''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], this base was constructed a short distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Restuss]] during the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] buildup leading to the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SWG:TBoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Base near Restuss was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Base was added to the game along with the "[[W:c:swg:Restuss|Battle of Restuss]]" [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|PvP]] battlefield,<ref name="SWG:TBoR" /> introduced in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1.1|Chapter 1.1]]" released on [[June 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
